public interface SimulationEngineModule
Common operational contract for all planetary simulation engines across Tier 1 (biophysical conservation laws) and Tier 2 (cliodynamic, macroeconomic, and historical scenario hypotheses).

Enforces zero static state leaks, standardized per-tick execution over continuous Data-Oriented Design WorldBuffer primitive memory tensors, and deterministic resets.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • isEnabled

      boolean isEnabled(Scenario scenario)
      Determines whether this engine is active for the specified scenario.

    • tick

      void tick(WorldBuffer buffer, double dtYears, double dtMonthly)
      Executes one temporal simulation step over the data-oriented planetary buffers.
      Parameters:
      buffer - data-oriented world memory buffer
      dtYears - elapsed time step in Julian years
      dtMonthly - elapsed time step as a monthly fraction

    • reset

      void reset()
      Resets all internal instance states, cumulative accumulators, and caches. Guarantees zero cross-scenario state leakage.

    • supportsCellularDerivatives

      default boolean supportsCellularDerivatives()

    • accumulateCellularDerivatives

      default void accumulateCellularDerivatives(WorldBuffer buffer, int cellIndex, double dtYears, double dtMonthly, DerivativeAccumulator accumulator)
      Accumulates local derivative increments for a single cell slot during the fused DoD pass.
      Parameters:
      buffer - contiguous world memory buffer
      cellIndex - index of the cell in the contiguous buffer
      dtYears - elapsed time step in Julian years
      dtMonthly - elapsed time step as a monthly fraction
